brick:Velocity_Pressure_Sensor.label: Velocity Pressure Sensor
brick:Velocity_Pressure_Sensor.definition: Measures the difference between total pressure and static pressure

brick:Air_Loop.label: Air Loop
brick:Air_Loop.definition: The set of connected equipment serving one path of air

brick:Breaker_Panel.label: Breaker Panel
brick:Breaker_Panel.definition: Breaker Panel distributes power into various end-uses.

brick:Bus_Riser.label: Bus Riser
brick:Bus_Riser.definition: Bus Risers are commonly fed from a switchgear and rise up through a series of floors to the main power distribution source for each floor.

brick:Compressor.label: Compressor
brick:Compressor.definition: (1) device for mechanically increasing the pressure of a gas. (2) often described as being either open, hermetic, or semihermetic to describe how the compressor and motor drive is situated in relation to the gas or vapor being compressed. Types include centrifugal, axial flow, reciprocating, rotary screw, rotary vane, scroll, or diaphragm. 1. device for mechanically increasing the pressure of a gas. 2. specific machine, with or without accessories, for compressing refrigerant vapor.

brick:Economizer.label: Economizer
brick:Economizer.definition: Device that, on proper variable sensing, initiates control signals or actions to conserve energy. A control system that reduces the mechanical heating and cooling requirement.

brick:Elevator.label: Elevator
brick:Elevator.definition: A device that provides vertical transportation between floors, levels or decks of a building, vessel or other structure

brick:Humidifier.label: Humidifier
brick:Humidifier.definition: A device that adds moisture to air or other gases

brick:Lighting_System.label: Lighting System
brick:Lighting_System.definition: The equipment, devices and interfaces that serve or are a part of the lighting subsystem in a building

brick:Luminaire.label: Luminaire
brick:Luminaire.definition: A complete lighting unit consisting of a lamp or lamps and ballast(s) (when applicable) together with the parts designed to distribute the light, to position and protect the lamps, and to connect the lamps to the power supply.

brick:PlugStrip.label: PlugStrip
brick:PlugStrip.definition: A device containing a block of electrical sockets allowing multiple electrical devices to be powered from a single electrical socket.

brick:Point_Collection.label: Point Collection
brick:Point_Collection.definition: Nestable collections of associated points with a label, e.g. to model associations of points for display, configuration, packaging, and other user-defined needs

brick:Refrigeration_System.label: Refrigeration System
brick:Refrigeration_System.definition: System designed to remove heat from a space or substance, typically using a refrigerant in a closed loop

brick:Steam_System.label: Steam System
brick:Steam_System.definition: The equipment, devices and conduits that handle the production and distribution of steam in a building

brick:Transformer.label: Transformer
brick:Transformer.definition: A Transformer is usually fed by a high-voltage source and then steps down the voltage to a lower-voltage feed for low-voltage application (such as lights). Transformers also can step up voltage, but this generally does not apply to in building distribution.

brick:Waste_Meter.label: Waste Meter
brick:Waste_Meter.definition: A Waste Meter is used for tracking and categorizing various waste types in a building, aiding in waste management facilitating waste reduction, recycling, and disposal strategies.

brick:Absorption_Chiller.label: Absorption Chiller
brick:Absorption_Chiller.definition: A chiller that utilizes a thermal or/and chemical process to produce the refrigeration effect necessary to provide chilled water. There is no mechanical compression of the refrigerant taking place within the machine, as occurs within more traditional vapor compression type chillers.

brick:Air_System.label: Air System
brick:Air_System.definition: The equipment, distribution systems and terminals that introduce or exhaust, either collectively or individually, the air into and from the building

brick:Availability_Status.label: Availability Status
brick:Availability_Status.definition: Indicates if a piece of equipment, system, or functionality is available for operation

brick:Backflow_Preventer_Valve.label: Backflow Preventer Valve
brick:Backflow_Preventer_Valve.definition: Valve designed to prevent the reverse flow of fluid, typically water, thereby protecting potable water supplies from contamination or pollution.

brick:Boiler_Command.label: Boiler Command
brick:Boiler_Command.definition: A command to control a boiler

brick:Booster_Fan.label: Booster Fan
brick:Booster_Fan.definition: Fan activated to increase airflow beyond what is provided by the default configuration

brick:Bypass_Damper.label: Bypass Damper
brick:Bypass_Damper.definition: A bypass damper is a type of damper that is employed in forced-air bypass applications to reduce the buildup of static pressure, usually when certain zone dampers are closed.

brick:Ceiling_Fan.label: Ceiling Fan
brick:Ceiling_Fan.definition: A fan installed on the ceiling of a room for the purpose of air circulation

brick:Centrifugal_Chiller.label: Centrifugal Chiller
brick:Centrifugal_Chiller.definition: A chiller that uses the vapor compression cycle to chill water. It throws off the heat collected from the chilled water plus the heat from the compressor to a water loop

brick:Check_Valve.label: Check Valve
brick:Check_Valve.definition: Valve that allows fluid to flow in only one direction, preventing reverse flow.

brick:Chilled_Water_Loop.label: Chilled Water Loop
brick:Chilled_Water_Loop.definition: A collection of equipment that transport and regulate chilled water among each other

brick:Chilled_Water_System.label: Chilled Water System
brick:Chilled_Water_System.definition: The equipment, devices and conduits that handle the production and distribution of chilled water in a building

brick:Circuit_Breaker.label: Circuit Breaker
brick:Circuit_Breaker.definition: A circuit breaker is a safety device to prevent damage to devices in a circuit, such as electric motors, and wiring when the current flowing through the electrical circuit supersedes its design limits. It does this by removing the current from a circuit when an unsafe condition arises. Unlike a switch, a circuit breaker automatically does this and shuts off the power immediately.

brick:Condenser_Water_Loop.label: Condenser Water Loop
brick:Condenser_Water_Loop.definition: A collection of equipment that transport and regulate condenser water among each other

brick:Condenser_Water_System.label: Condenser Water System
brick:Condenser_Water_System.definition: A heat rejection system consisting of (typically) cooling towers, condenser water pumps, chillers and the piping connecting the components

brick:Contact_Sensor.label: Contact Sensor
brick:Contact_Sensor.definition: Senses or detects contact, such as for determining if a door is closed.

brick:Cooling_Command.label: Cooling Command
brick:Cooling_Command.definition: Controls the amount of cooling to be delivered (typically as a proportion of total cooling output)

brick:Cooling_Tower.label: Cooling Tower
brick:Cooling_Tower.definition: A cooling tower is a heat rejection device that rejects waste heat to the atmosphere through the cooling of a water stream to a lower temperature. Cooling towers may either use the evaporation of water to remove process heat and cool the working fluid to near the wet-bulb air temperature or, in the case of closed circuit dry cooling towers, rely solely on air to cool the working fluid to near the dry-bulb air temperature.

brick:Cooling_Valve.label: Cooling Valve
brick:Cooling_Valve.definition: A valve that controls air temperature by modulating the amount of cold water flowing through a cooling coil

brick:Dehumidify_Command.label: Dehumidify Command
brick:Dehumidify_Command.definition: Triggers the dehumidification process, actively removing moisture from the air to achieve desired humidity levels

brick:Direction_Command.label: Direction Command
brick:Direction_Command.definition: Commands that affect the direction of some phenomenon

brick:Disable_Status.label: Disable Status
brick:Disable_Status.definition: Indicates if functionality has been disabled

brick:Discharge_Air_Temperature_Proporti.label: Discharge Air Temperature Proportional Band Parameter

brick:Discharge_Air_Temperature_Reset_Di.label: Discharge Air Temperature Reset Differential Setpoint

brick:Economizer_Damper.label: Economizer Damper
brick:Economizer_Damper.definition: A damper that is part of an economizer that is used to module the flow of air

brick:Electric_Boiler.label: Electric Boiler
brick:Electric_Boiler.definition: A closed, pressure vessel that uses electricity for heating water or other fluids to supply steam or hot water for heating, humidification, or other applications.

brick:Electrical_System.label: Electrical System
brick:Electrical_System.definition: Devices that serve or are part of the electrical subsystem in the building

brick:Exhaust_Damper.label: Exhaust Damper
brick:Exhaust_Damper.definition: A damper that modulates the flow of exhaust air

brick:Final_Filter.label: Final Filter
brick:Final_Filter.definition: The last, high-efficiency filter installed in a sequence to remove the finest particulates from the substance being filtered

brick:Fire_Safety_System.label: Fire Safety System
brick:Fire_Safety_System.definition: A system containing devices and equipment that monitor, detect and suppress fire hazards

brick:Freeze_Status.label: Freeze Status
brick:Freeze_Status.definition: Indicates if a substance contained within a vessel has frozen

brick:Frost_Sensor.label: Frost Sensor
brick:Frost_Sensor.definition: Senses the presence of frost or conditions that may cause frost

brick:Fume_Hood.label: Fume Hood
brick:Fume_Hood.definition: A fume hood is a type of local exhaust ventilation device designed to protect users from exposure to hazardous fumes, vapors, and dust. It is typically mounted over a workspace, table, or shelf to capture and conduct unwanted gases away from the enclosed area.

brick:Gas_Distribution.label: Gas Distribution
brick:Gas_Distribution.definition: Utilize a gas distribution source to represent how gas is distributed across multiple destinations

brick:Grease_Interceptor.label: Grease Interceptor
brick:Grease_Interceptor.definition: A larger, more industrial version of a grease trap designed to handle higher volumes of wastewater and more efficiently separate grease and fats.

brick:Hail_Sensor.label: Hail Sensor
brick:Hail_Sensor.definition: Measures hail in terms of its size and damage potential

brick:Heat_Wheel.label: Heat Wheel
brick:Heat_Wheel.definition: A rotary heat exchanger positioned within the supply and exhaust air streams of an air handling system in order to recover heat energy

brick:Heating_Command.label: Heating Command
brick:Heating_Command.definition: Controls the amount of heating to be delivered (typically as a proportion of total heating output)

brick:Hot_Water_Loop.label: Hot Water Loop
brick:Hot_Water_Loop.definition: A collection of equipment that transport and regulate hot water among each other

brick:Induction_Unit.label: Induction Unit
brick:Induction_Unit.definition: A device with an primary air connection and integrated coil and condensate pan that performs sensible and latent cooling of a space. Essentially an Active Chilled Beam with a built in condensate pan.

brick:Inverter.label: Inverter
brick:Inverter.definition: A device that changes direct current into alternating current

brick:Isolation_Damper.label: Isolation Damper
brick:Isolation_Damper.definition: A damper that isolates a section of ductwork or other air handling system.

brick:Level_Command.label: Level Command
brick:Level_Command.definition: Adjusts the operational state to a specific level within a predefined range.

brick:Level_Status.label: Level Status
brick:Level_Status.definition: The current operational state of a specific level within a predefined range.

brick:Light_Source.label: Light Source
brick:Light_Source.definition: A light-emitting component of a lighting device or luminaire

brick:Lockout_Status.label: Lockout Status
brick:Lockout_Status.definition: Indicates if a piece of equipment, system, or functionality has been locked out from operation

brick:Luminaire_Driver.label: Luminaire Driver
brick:Luminaire_Driver.definition: A power source for a luminaire

brick:Luminance_Command.label: Luminance Command
brick:Luminance_Command.definition: Controls the amount of luminance delivered by a lighting system

brick:Luminance_Sensor.label: Luminance Sensor
brick:Luminance_Sensor.definition: Measures the luminous intensity per unit area of light travelling in a given direction

brick:Max_Cooling_Discharge_Air_Flow_Set.label: Max Cooling Discharge Air Flow Setpoint Limit

brick:Max_Heating_Discharge_Air_Flow_Set.label: Max Heating Discharge Air Flow Setpoint Limit

brick:Min_Cooling_Discharge_Air_Flow_Set.label: Min Cooling Discharge Air Flow Setpoint Limit

brick:Min_Heating_Discharge_Air_Flow_Set.label: Min Heating Discharge Air Flow Setpoint Limit

brick:Mixed_Damper.label: Mixed Damper
brick:Mixed_Damper.definition: A damper that modulates the flow of the mixed outside and return air streams

brick:Motor_Control_Center.label: Motor Control Center
brick:Motor_Control_Center.definition: The Motor Control Center is a specialized type of switchgear which provides electrical power to major mechanical systems in the building such as HVAC components.

brick:Occupancy_Command.label: Occupancy Command
brick:Occupancy_Command.definition: Controls whether or not a device or controller is operating in "Occupied" mode

brick:Occupancy_Sensor.label: Occupancy Sensor
brick:Occupancy_Sensor.definition: Detects occupancy of some space or area

brick:Off_Command.label: Off Command
brick:Off_Command.definition: An Off Command controls or reports the binary 'off' status of a control loop, relay or equipment activity. It can only be used to stop/deactivate an associated equipment or process, or determine that the related entity is 'off'

brick:On_Command.label: On Command
brick:On_Command.definition: An On Command controls or reports the binary 'on' status of a control loop, relay or equipment activity. It can only be used to start/activate an associated equipment or process, or determine that the related entity is 'on'

brick:Outside_Damper.label: Outside Damper
brick:Outside_Damper.definition: A damper that modulates the flow of outside air

brick:Overload_Alarm.label: Overload Alarm
brick:Overload_Alarm.definition: An alarm that can indicate when a full-load current is exceeded.

brick:PIR_Sensor.label: PIR Sensor
brick:PIR_Sensor.definition: Detects the presense of motion in some area using the differential change in infrared intensity between two or more receptors

brick:PV_Generation_System.label: PV Generation System
brick:PV_Generation_System.definition: A collection of photovoltaic devices that generates energy

brick:Photovoltaic_Inverter.label: Photovoltaic Inverter
brick:Photovoltaic_Inverter.definition: Converts direct current electricity generated by solar panels into alternating current

brick:Piezoelectric_Sensor.label: Piezoelectric Sensor
brick:Piezoelectric_Sensor.definition: Senses changes pressure, acceleration, temperature, force or strain via the piezoelectric effect

brick:Pre_Filter.label: Pre Filter
brick:Pre_Filter.definition: A filter installed in front of a more efficient filter to extend the life of the more expensive higher efficiency filter

brick:Preheat_Command.label: Preheat Command
brick:Preheat_Command.definition: A command to activate preheating. Typically used to preheat cool air coming from a mixing box or economizer

brick:Pressurization_Fan.label: Pressurization Fan
brick:Pressurization_Fan.definition: A pressurization fan is a device used to increase and maintain higher air pressure in a specified space compared to its surroundings.

brick:Pump_Command.label: Pump Command
brick:Pump_Command.definition: Controls or reports the speed of a pump (typically as a proportion of its full pumping capacity)

brick:Rain_Level_Sensor.label: Rain Level Sensor
brick:Rain_Level_Sensor.definition: Measures the amount of precipitation fallen

brick:Reheat_Command.label: Reheat Command
brick:Reheat_Command.definition: A command to activate reheating, which is used for either heating or for dehumidification purposes

brick:Relief_Damper.label: Relief Damper
brick:Relief_Damper.definition: A damper that is a component of a Relief Air System, ensuring building doesn't become over-pressurised

brick:Relief_Fan.label: Relief Fan
brick:Relief_Fan.definition: A fan that is a component of a Relief Air System, ensuring building doesn't become over-pressurised

brick:Return_Damper.label: Return Damper
brick:Return_Damper.definition: A damper that modulates the flow of return air

brick:Return_Fan.label: Return Fan
brick:Return_Fan.definition: Fan moving return air -- air that is circulated from the building back into the HVAC system

brick:Separation_Tank.label: Separation Tank
brick:Separation_Tank.definition: A tank used in conjunction with a filter to facilitate the separation of filtrate material for disposal.

brick:Shading_System.label: Shading System
brick:Shading_System.definition: Devices that can control daylighting through various means

brick:Space_Heater.label: Space Heater
brick:Space_Heater.definition: A heater used to warm the air in an enclosed area, such as a room or office

brick:Speed_Command.label: Speed Command
brick:Speed_Command.definition: A command to set speed to a certain degree.

brick:Stages_Status.label: Stages Status
brick:Stages_Status.definition: Indicates which stage a control loop or equipment is in

brick:Standby_CRAC.label: Standby CRAC
brick:Standby_CRAC.definition: A CRAC that is activated as part of a lead/lag operation or when an alarm occurs in a primary unit

brick:Standby_Fan.label: Standby Fan
brick:Standby_Fan.definition: Fan that is activated as part of a lead/lag operation or when a primary fan raises an alarm

brick:Steam_Distribution.label: Steam Distribution
brick:Steam_Distribution.definition: Utilize a steam distribution source to represent how steam is distributed across multiple destinations

brick:Thermostat.label: Thermostat
brick:Thermostat.definition: An automatic control device used to maintain temperature at a fixed or adjustable setpoint.

brick:Tint_Command.label: Tint Command
brick:Tint_Command.definition: The target level of window tint.

brick:Tint_Status.label: Tint Status
brick:Tint_Status.definition: The current level of window tint, errors, or transient states.

brick:Touchpanel.label: Touchpanel
brick:Touchpanel.definition: A switch used to operate all or part of a lighting installation that uses a touch-based mechanism (typically resistive or capacitive) rather than a mechanical actuator

brick:Transfer_Fan.label: Transfer Fan
brick:Transfer_Fan.definition: A fan that transfers air from a space to another space.

brick:Unit_Heater.label: Unit Heater
brick:Unit_Heater.definition: A self-contained non-ducted heater designed to heat large open spaces.

brick:Valve_Status.label: Valve Status
brick:Valve_Status.definition: The current status of the valve.

brick:Ventilation_Air_System.label: Ventilation Air System
brick:Ventilation_Air_System.definition: The equipment, devices, and conduits that handle the introduction and distribution of ventilation air in the building

brick:Waste_Amount_Sensor.label: Waste Amount Sensor
brick:Waste_Amount_Sensor.definition: A metric used for measuring the quantity of waste generated in a building.

brick:Water_Distribution.label: Water Distribution
brick:Water_Distribution.definition: Utilize a water distribution source to represent how water is distributed across multiple destinations (pipes)

brick:Zone_Damper.label: Zone Damper
brick:Zone_Damper.definition: Dampers open and close to regulate zone temperatures in an HVAC system.

brick:Active_Chilled_Beam.label: Active Chilled Beam
brick:Active_Chilled_Beam.definition: A Chilled Beam with an integral primary air connection that induces air flow through the device.

brick:Air_Cooled_Chiller.label: Air Cooled Chiller
brick:Air_Cooled_Chiller.definition: A chiller that uses air to cool the refrigerant, used in various commercial and industrial cooling applications

brick:Alarm_Delay_Parameter.label: Alarm Delay Parameter
brick:Alarm_Delay_Parameter.definition: A parameter determining how long to delay an alarm after sufficient conditions have been met

brick:Automatic_Mode_Command.label: Automatic Mode Command
brick:Automatic_Mode_Command.definition: Controls whether or not a device or controller is operating in "Automatic" mode

brick:Automatic_Tint_Window_Array.label: Automatic Tint Window Array
brick:Automatic_Tint_Window_Array.definition: An array of Automatic Tint Windows.

brick:Automatic_Transfer_Switch.label: Automatic Transfer Switch
brick:Automatic_Transfer_Switch.definition: An automatic transfer switch (ATS) is a device that automatically transfers a power supply from its primary source to a backup source when it senses a failure or outage in the primary source.

brick:Battery.label: Battery
brick:Battery.definition: A container that stores chemical energy that can be converted into electricity and used as a source of power

brick:Battery_Energy_Storage_System.label: Battery Energy Storage System
brick:Battery_Energy_Storage_System.definition: A collection of batteries that provides energy storage, along with their supporting equipment

brick:Battery_Voltage_Sensor.label: Battery Voltage Sensor
brick:Battery_Voltage_Sensor.definition: Measures the capacity of a battery

brick:Blind_Group.label: Blind Group
brick:Blind_Group.definition: A group of Blinds commonly attached to a single controller.

brick:Boiler.label: Boiler
brick:Boiler.definition: A closed, pressure vessel that uses fuel or electricity for heating water or other fluids to supply steam or hot water for heating, humidification, or other applications.

brick:Branch_Selector.label: Branch Selector
brick:Branch_Selector.definition: A device in VRF systems that regulates the flow of refrigerant to different indoor units or branches, ensuring optimal distribution of heating or cooling according to the specific requirements of each zone or area in the building.

brick:Building_Electrical_Meter.label: Building Electrical Meter
brick:Building_Electrical_Meter.definition: A meter that measures the usage or consumption of electricity of a whole building

brick:Building_Gas_Meter.label: Building Gas Meter
brick:Building_Gas_Meter.definition: A meter that measures the usage or consumption of gas of a whole building

brick:Building_Water_Meter.label: Building Water Meter
brick:Building_Water_Meter.definition: A meter that measures the usage or consumption of water of a whole building

brick:CO2_Alarm.label: CO2 Alarm
brick:CO2_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates the off-normal conditions associated with the presence of carbon dioxide.

brick:CO2_Differential_Sensor.label: CO2 Differential Sensor
brick:CO2_Differential_Sensor.definition: Measures the difference between CO2 levels of inside and outside air

brick:Change_Filter_Alarm.label: Change Filter Alarm
brick:Change_Filter_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates that a filter must be changed

brick:Chilled_Water_Storage_Tank.label: Chilled Water Storage Tank
brick:Chilled_Water_Storage_Tank.definition: A tank specifically designed to store chilled water in HVAC systems.

brick:Chilled_Water_Valve.label: Chilled Water Valve
brick:Chilled_Water_Valve.definition: A valve that modulates the flow of chilled water

brick:Close_Limit.label: Close Limit
brick:Close_Limit.definition: A parameter that places a lower or upper bound on the range of permitted values of a Close_Setpoint.

brick:Coil.label: Coil
brick:Coil.definition: Cooling or heating element made of pipe or tube that may or may not be finned and formed into helical or serpentine shape (ASHRAE Dictionary)

brick:Cold_Deck.label: Cold Deck
brick:Cold_Deck.definition: Part of a dual duct air handling unit that supplies cooling to a building

brick:Cold_Water_Storage_Tank.label: Cold Water Storage Tank
brick:Cold_Water_Storage_Tank.definition: A tank used to store cold water, usually in a building's water supply system.

brick:Communication_Loss_Alarm.label: Communication Loss Alarm
brick:Communication_Loss_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates a loss of communication e.g. with a device or controller

brick:Condensate_Leak_Alarm.label: Condensate Leak Alarm
brick:Condensate_Leak_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates a leak of condensate from a cooling system

brick:Condenser_Water_Valve.label: Condenser Water Valve
brick:Condenser_Water_Valve.definition: A valve that modulates the flow of condenser water

brick:Cooling_Demand_Setpoint.label: Cooling Demand Setpoint
brick:Cooling_Demand_Setpoint.definition: Sets the rate required for cooling

brick:Cooling_Enable_Command.label: Cooling Enable Command
brick:Cooling_Enable_Command.definition: Command that enables cooling functionality in equipment but certain condition(s) must be met first before actively cooling. For the actively cooling control, see Cooling_Command.

brick:Cooling_Tower_Fan.label: Cooling Tower Fan
brick:Cooling_Tower_Fan.definition: A fan that pulls air through a cooling tower and across the louvers where the water falls to aid in heat exchange by the process of evaporation

brick:Core_Temperature_Sensor.label: Core Temperature Sensor
brick:Core_Temperature_Sensor.definition: Measures the internal temperature of the radiant layer at the heat source or sink level of the radiant heating and cooling HVAC system.

brick:Core_Temperature_Setpoint.label: Core Temperature Setpoint
brick:Core_Temperature_Setpoint.definition: Sets temperature for the core, i.e. the temperature at the heat source or sink level, of the radiant panel.

brick:Current_Imbalance_Sensor.label: Current Imbalance Sensor
brick:Current_Imbalance_Sensor.definition: A sensor which measures the current difference (imbalance) between phases of an electrical system

brick:Current_Limit.label: Current Limit
brick:Current_Limit.definition: A parameter that places a lower or upper bound on the range of permitted values of a Current_Setpoint.

brick:Cycle_Alarm.label: Cycle Alarm
brick:Cycle_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates off-normal conditions associated with HVAC cycles

brick:Damper_Position_Command.label: Damper Position Command
brick:Damper_Position_Command.definition: Controls the position (the degree of openness) of a damper

brick:Damper_Position_Sensor.label: Damper Position Sensor
brick:Damper_Position_Sensor.definition: Measures the current position of a damper in terms of the percent of fully open

brick:Deionized_Water_Alarm.label: Deionized Water Alarm
brick:Deionized_Water_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates deionized water leaks.

brick:Delay_Parameter.label: Delay Parameter
brick:Delay_Parameter.definition: A parameter determining how long to delay a subsequent action to take place after a received signal

brick:Dimmer.label: Dimmer
brick:Dimmer.definition: A switch providing continuous control over all or part of a lighting installation; typically potentiometer-based

brick:Direction_Sensor.label: Direction Sensor
brick:Direction_Sensor.definition: Measures the direction in degrees in which a phenomenon is occuring

brick:Direction_Status.label: Direction Status
brick:Direction_Status.definition: Indicates which direction a device is operating in

brick:Domestic_Hot_Water_System.label: Domestic Hot Water System
brick:Domestic_Hot_Water_System.definition: The equipment, devices and conduits that handle the production and distribution of domestic hot water in a building

brick:Drive_Ready_Status.label: Drive Ready Status
brick:Drive_Ready_Status.definition: Indicates if a hard drive or other storage device is ready to be used, e.g. in the context of RAID

brick:Dry_Cooler.label: Dry Cooler
brick:Dry_Cooler.definition: A dry cooler is a fluid cooler that uses air, a relatively dry, non-liquid fluid to accomplish process cooling. (https://submer.com/submer-academy/library/dry-cooler/)

brick:Electric_Baseboard_Radiator.label: Electric Baseboard Radiator
brick:Electric_Baseboard_Radiator.definition: Electric heating device located at or near the floor

brick:Electrical_Meter.label: Electrical Meter
brick:Electrical_Meter.definition: A meter that measures the usage or consumption of electricity

brick:Electronic_Mixing_Valve.label: Electronic Mixing Valve
brick:Electronic_Mixing_Valve.definition: Electronically controlled valve for precise mixing of hot and cold fluid.

brick:Emergency_Alarm.label: Emergency Alarm
brick:Emergency_Alarm.definition: Alarms that indicate off-normal conditions associated with emergency systems

brick:Emergency_Generator_Alarm.label: Emergency Generator Alarm
brick:Emergency_Generator_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates off-normal conditions associated with an emergency generator

brick:Emergency_Generator_Status.label: Emergency Generator Status
brick:Emergency_Generator_Status.definition: Indicates if an emergency generator is active

brick:Emergency_Power_Off_System.label: Emergency Power Off System
brick:Emergency_Power_Off_System.definition: A system that can power down a single piece of equipment or a single system from a single point

brick:Enable_Status.label: Enable Status
brick:Enable_Status.definition: Indicates if a system or piece of functionality has been enabled

brick:Energy_Generation_Sensor.label: Energy Generation Sensor
brick:Energy_Generation_Sensor.definition: A sensor measuring the amount of generated energy.

brick:Energy_Generation_System.label: Energy Generation System
brick:Energy_Generation_System.definition: A collection of devices that generates electricity

brick:Energy_Storage.label: Energy Storage
brick:Energy_Storage.definition: Devices or equipment that store energy in its various forms

brick:Energy_Storage_System.label: Energy Storage System
brick:Energy_Storage_System.definition: A collection of devices that stores electricity

brick:Energy_System.label: Energy System
brick:Energy_System.definition: A collection of devices that generates, stores or transports electricity

brick:Enthalpy_Sensor.label: Enthalpy Sensor
brick:Enthalpy_Sensor.definition: Measures the total heat content of some substance

brick:Exhaust_Fan.label: Exhaust Fan
brick:Exhaust_Fan.definition: Fan moving exhaust air -- air that must be removed from a space due to contaminants

brick:Filter_Status.label: Filter Status
brick:Filter_Status.definition: Indicates if a filter needs to be replaced

brick:Fire_Sprinkler_Water_Storage_Tank.label: Fire Sprinkler Water Storage Tank
brick:Fire_Sprinkler_Water_Storage_Tank.definition: A specialized tank intended to store water that can be quickly accessed for fire suppression.

brick:Formaldehyde_Level_Sensor.label: Formaldehyde Level Sensor
brick:Formaldehyde_Level_Sensor.definition: Measures the concentration of formaldehyde in air

brick:Frequency_Sensor.label: Frequency Sensor
brick:Frequency_Sensor.definition: Measures the frequency of a phenomenon or aspect of a phenomenon, e.g. the frequency of a fan turning

brick:Gas_Meter.label: Gas Meter
brick:Gas_Meter.definition: A meter that measures the usage or consumption of gas

brick:Gas_Pressure_Regulator_Valve.label: Gas Pressure Regulator Valve
brick:Gas_Pressure_Regulator_Valve.definition: Valve designed to maintain controlled downstream gas pressure with varying upstream pressure.

brick:Generation_Sensor.label: Generation Sensor
brick:Generation_Sensor.definition: A sensor measuring how much something has been generated.

brick:Heat_Sink_Temperature_Sensor.label: Heat Sink Temperature Sensor
brick:Heat_Sink_Temperature_Sensor.definition: Measure temperature of the heat sink on a device such as a VFD.

brick:Heat_Wheel_VFD.label: Heat Wheel VFD
brick:Heat_Wheel_VFD.definition: A VFD that drives a heat wheel

brick:Heating_Demand_Setpoint.label: Heating Demand Setpoint
brick:Heating_Demand_Setpoint.definition: Sets the rate required for heating

brick:Heating_Enable_Command.label: Heating Enable Command
brick:Heating_Enable_Command.definition: Command that enables heating functionality in equipment but certain condition(s) must be met first before actively heating. For the actively heating control, see Heating_Command.

brick:High_CO2_Alarm.label: High CO2 Alarm
brick:High_CO2_Alarm.definition: A device that indicates high concentration of carbon dioxide.

brick:High_Humidity_Alarm.label: High Humidity Alarm
brick:High_Humidity_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates high concentration of water vapor in the air.

brick:Hot_Deck.label: Hot Deck
brick:Hot_Deck.definition: Part of a dual duct air handling unit that supplies heating to a building

brick:Hot_Water_Storage_Tank.label: Hot Water Storage Tank
brick:Hot_Water_Storage_Tank.definition: A tank designed to store hot water in an HVAC system.

brick:Humidifier_Fault_Status.label: Humidifier Fault Status
brick:Humidifier_Fault_Status.definition: Indicates the presence of a fault in a humidifier

brick:Humidity_Deadband_Setpoint.label: Humidity Deadband Setpoint
brick:Humidity_Deadband_Setpoint.definition: Sets the size of a deadband of humidity

brick:Humidity_Tolerance_Parameter.label: Humidity Tolerance Parameter
brick:Humidity_Tolerance_Parameter.definition: A parameter determining the difference between upper and lower limits of humidity.

brick:Illuminance_Sensor.label: Illuminance Sensor
brick:Illuminance_Sensor.definition: Measures the total luminous flux incident on a surface, per unit area

brick:Interface.label: Interface
brick:Interface.definition: A device that provides an occupant control over a lighting system

brick:Lead_Lag_Status.label: Lead Lag Status
brick:Lead_Lag_Status.definition: Indicates if lead/lag operation is enabled

brick:Leak_Alarm.label: Leak Alarm
brick:Leak_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates leaks occured in systems containing fluids

brick:Load_Current_Sensor.label: Load Current Sensor
brick:Load_Current_Sensor.definition: Measures the current consumed by a load

brick:Low_Battery_Alarm.label: Low Battery Alarm
brick:Low_Battery_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates the battery is low.

brick:Low_Humidity_Alarm.label: Low Humidity Alarm
brick:Low_Humidity_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates low concentration of water vapor in the air.

brick:Low_Voltage_Alarm.label: Low Voltage Alarm
brick:Low_Voltage_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates the voltage is lower than its normal state.

brick:Main_Circuit_Breaker.label: Main Circuit Breaker
brick:Main_Circuit_Breaker.definition: All breaker panels generally have a main circuit breaker before the bus / MCBs. In some older panels there may be a Main Disconnect Switch instead. It is also possible to have a main disconnect switch, and a main circuit breaker in a panel.

brick:Maintenance_Mode_Command.label: Maintenance Mode Command
brick:Maintenance_Mode_Command.definition: Controls whether or not a device or controller is operating in "Maintenance" mode

brick:Maintenance_Required_Alarm.label: Maintenance Required Alarm
brick:Maintenance_Required_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates that repair/maintenance is required on an associated device or equipment

brick:Manual_Auto_Status.label: Manual Auto Status
brick:Manual_Auto_Status.definition: Indicates if a system is under manual or automatic operation

brick:Methane_Level_Sensor.label: Methane Level Sensor
brick:Methane_Level_Sensor.definition: Measures the concentration of methane in air

brick:Mixed_Air_Filter.label: Mixed Air Filter
brick:Mixed_Air_Filter.definition: A filter that is applied to the mixture of recirculated and outside air

brick:Mixing_Valve.label: Mixing Valve
brick:Mixing_Valve.definition: Valve used for mixing hot and cold fluid to a desired temperature.

brick:Motion_Sensor.label: Motion Sensor
brick:Motion_Sensor.definition: Detects the presence of motion in some area

brick:Motor.label: Motor
brick:Motor.definition: A machine in which power is applied to do work by the conversion of various forms of energy into mechanical force and motion.

brick:Motor_Current_Sensor.label: Motor Current Sensor
brick:Motor_Current_Sensor.definition: Measures the current consumed by a motor

brick:Motor_Direction_Status.label: Motor Direction Status
brick:Motor_Direction_Status.definition: Indicates which direction a motor is operating in, e.g. forward or reverse

brick:Motor_Torque_Sensor.label: Motor Torque Sensor
brick:Motor_Torque_Sensor.definition: Measures the torque, or rotating power, of a motor

brick:NO2_Level_Sensor.label: NO2 Level Sensor
brick:NO2_Level_Sensor.definition: Measures the concentration of NO2 in air

brick:No_Water_Alarm.label: No Water Alarm
brick:No_Water_Alarm.definition: Alarm indicating that there is no water in the equipment or system

brick:Occupancy_Count_Sensor.label: Occupancy Count Sensor
brick:Occupancy_Count_Sensor.definition: Sensors measuring the number of people in an area

brick:Occupancy_Status.label: Occupancy Status
brick:Occupancy_Status.definition: Indicates if a room or space is occupied

brick:Occupied_Humidity_Setpoint.label: Occupied Humidity Setpoint
brick:Occupied_Humidity_Setpoint.definition: Target humidity level when the location is occupied.

brick:Open_Close_Command.label: Open Close Command
brick:Open_Close_Command.definition: A binary signal given to a device, such as a damper or valve, to either open or close

brick:Open_Close_Status.label: Open Close Status
brick:Open_Close_Status.definition: Indicates the open/close status of a device such as a damper or valve

brick:Output_Voltage_Sensor.label: Output Voltage Sensor
brick:Output_Voltage_Sensor.definition: Measures the voltage output by some process or device

brick:Outside_Fan.label: Outside Fan
brick:Outside_Fan.definition: Fan moving outside air; air that is supplied into the building from the outdoors

brick:Outside_Illuminance_Sensor.label: Outside Illuminance Sensor
brick:Outside_Illuminance_Sensor.definition: Measures the total luminous flux incident on an outside, per unit area

brick:Overridden_Off_Status.label: Overridden Off Status
brick:Overridden_Off_Status.definition: Indicates if a control loop, relay or equipment has been turned off when it would otherwise be scheduled to be on

brick:Overridden_On_Status.label: Overridden On Status
brick:Overridden_On_Status.definition: Indicates if a control loop, relay or equipment has been turned on when it would otherwise be scheduled to be off

brick:Override_Command.label: Override Command
brick:Override_Command.definition: Controls or reports whether or not a device or control loop is in 'override'

brick:Ozone_Level_Sensor.label: Ozone Level Sensor
brick:Ozone_Level_Sensor.definition: Measures the concentration of ozone in air

brick:Passive_Chilled_Beam.label: Passive Chilled Beam
brick:Passive_Chilled_Beam.definition: A chilled beam that does not have an integral air supply and instead relies on natural convection to draw air through the device.

brick:Power_Alarm.label: Power Alarm
brick:Power_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates the off-normal conditions associated with electrical power.

brick:Power_Factor_Sensor.label: Power Factor Sensor
brick:Power_Factor_Sensor.definition: Sensors measuring power Factor, under periodic conditions, is the ratio of the absolute value of the active power (P) to the apparent power (S).

brick:Power_Loss_Alarm.label: Power Loss Alarm
brick:Power_Loss_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates a power failure.

brick:Pre-Cooling_Air_Unit.label: Pre-Cooling Air Unit
brick:Pre-Cooling_Air_Unit.definition: A type of AHU, use to pre-treat the outdoor air before feed to AHU

brick:Pre_Filter_Status.label: Pre Filter Status
brick:Pre_Filter_Status.definition: Indicates if a prefilter needs to be replaced

brick:Preheat_Demand_Setpoint.label: Preheat Demand Setpoint
brick:Preheat_Demand_Setpoint.definition: Sets the rate required for preheat

brick:Pressure_Regulator_Valve.label: Pressure Regulator Valve
brick:Pressure_Regulator_Valve.definition: Device to maintain controlled downstream fluid pressure with varying upstream pressure.

brick:Radon_Concentration_Sensor.label: Radon Concentration Sensor
brick:Radon_Concentration_Sensor.definition: Measures the concentration of radioactivity due to radon

brick:Rain_Duration_Sensor.label: Rain Duration Sensor
brick:Rain_Duration_Sensor.definition: Measures the duration of precipitation within some time frame

brick:Rain_Water_Storage_Tank.label: Rain Water Storage Tank
brick:Rain_Water_Storage_Tank.definition: A tank engineered to capture and store rainwater, usually for non-potable uses.

brick:Reheat_Valve.label: Reheat Valve
brick:Reheat_Valve.definition: A valve that controls air temperature by modulating the amount of hot water flowing through a reheat coil

brick:Return_Air_Plenum.label: Return Air Plenum
brick:Return_Air_Plenum.definition: A component of the HVAC the receives air from the room to recirculate or exhaust to or from the building

brick:Return_Heating_Valve.label: Return Heating Valve
brick:Return_Heating_Valve.definition: A valve installed on the return side of a heat exchanger

brick:Run_Request_Status.label: Run Request Status
brick:Run_Request_Status.definition: Indicates if a request has been filed to start a device or equipment

brick:Sash_Position_Sensor.label: Sash Position Sensor
brick:Sash_Position_Sensor.definition: Measures the current position of a sash in terms of the percent of fully open

brick:Schedule_Temperature_Setpoint.label: Schedule Temperature Setpoint
brick:Schedule_Temperature_Setpoint.definition: The current setpoint as indicated by the schedule

brick:Short_Cycle_Alarm.label: Short Cycle Alarm
brick:Short_Cycle_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates a short cycle occurred. A short cycle occurs when a cooling cycle is prevented from completing its full cycle

brick:Smoke_Alarm.label: Smoke Alarm
brick:Smoke_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates the off-normal conditions associated with smoke.

brick:Stage_Enable_Command.label: Stage Enable Command
brick:Stage_Enable_Command.definition: A point representing a discrete stage which the equipment should be operating at. The desired stage number should be identified by an entity property

brick:Start_Stop_Command.label: Start Stop Command
brick:Start_Stop_Command.definition: A Start/Stop Command controls or reports the active/inactive status of a control sequence

brick:Static_Transfer_Switch.label: Static Transfer Switch
brick:Static_Transfer_Switch.definition: Similar to ATS, but utilises no moving parts in the switch to achieve much faster response times.

brick:Steam_Baseboard_Radiator.label: Steam Baseboard Radiator
brick:Steam_Baseboard_Radiator.definition: Steam heating device located at or near the floor

brick:Steam_Pressure_Reducing_Valve.label: Steam Pressure Reducing Valve
brick:Steam_Pressure_Reducing_Valve.definition: Valve designed to reduce steam pressure from a high to a manageable level; maintains uniform steam outlet pressure.

brick:Steam_Pressure_Relief_Valve.label: Steam Pressure Relief Valve
brick:Steam_Pressure_Relief_Valve.definition: Valve designed to automatically relieve excessive steam pressure.

brick:Steam_Usage_Sensor.label: Steam Usage Sensor
brick:Steam_Usage_Sensor.definition: Measures the amount of steam that is consumed or used, over some period of time

brick:Switch.label: Switch
brick:Switch.definition: A switch used to operate all or part of a lighting installation

brick:System_Shutdown_Status.label: System Shutdown Status
brick:System_Shutdown_Status.definition: Indicates if a system has been shutdown

brick:Tablet.label: Tablet
brick:Tablet.definition: A flat, handheld mobile computer, usually with a touchscreen

brick:Temperature_Tolerance_Parameter.label: Temperature Tolerance Parameter
brick:Temperature_Tolerance_Parameter.definition: A parameter determining the difference between upper and lower limits of temperature.

brick:Temporary_Occupancy_Status.label: Temporary Occupancy Status
brick:Temporary_Occupancy_Status.definition: For systems that differentiate between scheduled occupied/unoccupied mode, this indicates if a space is temporarily occupied when it would otherwise be unoccupied

brick:Thermostatic_Mixing_Valve.label: Thermostatic Mixing Valve
brick:Thermostatic_Mixing_Valve.definition: A valve that blends hot water with cold water to ensure constant, safe shower and bath outlet temperatures, preventing scalding.

brick:Torque_Sensor.label: Torque Sensor
brick:Torque_Sensor.definition: Measures torque, the tendency of a force to rotate an object about some axis

brick:Underfloor_Air_Plenum.label: Underfloor Air Plenum
brick:Underfloor_Air_Plenum.definition: An open space between a structural concrete slab and the underside of a raised access floor system that connects to an air handling unit to receive conditioned and/or ventilating air before delivery to the room(s)

brick:Unit_Failure_Alarm.label: Unit Failure Alarm
brick:Unit_Failure_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates the failure of an equipment or device

brick:Unoccupied_Humidity_Setpoint.label: Unoccupied Humidity Setpoint
brick:Unoccupied_Humidity_Setpoint.definition: Target humidity level when the location is unoccupied.

brick:VFD_Enable_Command.label: VFD Enable Command
brick:VFD_Enable_Command.definition: Enables operation of a variable frequency drive

brick:Valve_Command.label: Valve Command
brick:Valve_Command.definition: Controls or reports the openness of a valve (typically as a proportion of its full range of motion)

brick:Valve_Position_Alarm.label: Valve Position Alarm
brick:Valve_Position_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates that the valve position is not in a normal state.

brick:Valve_Position_Command.label: Valve Position Command
brick:Valve_Position_Command.definition: Controls the position (the degree of openness) of a valve

brick:Valve_Position_Sensor.label: Valve Position Sensor
brick:Valve_Position_Sensor.definition: Measures the current position of a valve in terms of the percent of fully open

brick:Voltage_Alarm.label: Voltage Alarm
brick:Voltage_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates the voltage is not in a normal state.

brick:Voltage_Imbalance_Sensor.label: Voltage Imbalance Sensor
brick:Voltage_Imbalance_Sensor.definition: A sensor which measures the voltage difference (imbalance) between phases of an electrical system

brick:Wall_Air_Conditioner.label: Wall Air Conditioner
brick:Wall_Air_Conditioner.definition: A wall air conditioner, also known as a window air conditioner when installed in a window frame, is a self-contained unit that cools a room by drawing in warm air, cooling it over a refrigerant coil, and recirculating it back into the space.

brick:Water_Cooled_Chiller.label: Water Cooled Chiller
brick:Water_Cooled_Chiller.definition: A chiller system using water in the heat exchange process, employed in industrial or commercial facilities for cooling

brick:Water_Loss_Alarm.label: Water Loss Alarm
brick:Water_Loss_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates a loss of water e.g. during transport

brick:Water_Pressure_Reducing_Valve.label: Water Pressure Reducing Valve
brick:Water_Pressure_Reducing_Valve.definition: Valve specifically designed to reduce high water pressure to a usable level; maintains uniform water outlet pressure.

brick:Water_Pressure_Relief_Valve.label: Water Pressure Relief Valve
brick:Water_Pressure_Relief_Valve.definition: Valve designed to automatically relieve excessive water pressure.

brick:Wind_Direction_Sensor.label: Wind Direction Sensor
brick:Wind_Direction_Sensor.definition: Measures the direction of wind in degrees relative to North

brick:Wind_Speed_Sensor.label: Wind Speed Sensor
brick:Wind_Speed_Sensor.definition: Measured speed of wind, caused by air moving from high to low pressure

brick:Absolute_Humidity_Sensor.label: Absolute Humidity Sensor
brick:Absolute_Humidity_Sensor.definition: Measures the present state of absolute humidity

brick:Active_Power_Sensor.label: Active Power Sensor
brick:Active_Power_Sensor.definition: Measures the portion of power that, averaged over a complete cycle of the AC waveform, results in net transfer of energy in one direction

brick:Adjust_Sensor.label: Adjust Sensor
brick:Adjust_Sensor.definition: Measures user-provided adjustment of some value

brick:Air_Cooled_Condenser_Heat_Exchange.label: Air Cooled Condenser Heat Exchanger
brick:Air_Cooled_Condenser_Heat_Exchange.definition: A type of heat exchanger used in refrigeration and air conditioning systems where the primary refrigerant vapor condenses into liquid by transferring heat to ambient air. It typically consists of finned tubes exposed to forced airflow.

brick:Air_Flow_Loss_Alarm.label: Air Flow Loss Alarm
brick:Air_Flow_Loss_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates loss in air flow.

brick:Air_Pressure_Sensor.label: Air Pressure Sensor
brick:Air_Pressure_Sensor.definition: Measures the pressure of the surrounding air.

brick:Angle_Sensor.label: Angle Sensor
brick:Angle_Sensor.definition: Measues the planar angle of some phenomenon

brick:Apparent_Power_Sensor.label: Apparent Power Sensor
brick:Apparent_Power_Sensor.definition: Measures apparent power in an AC electrical system

brick:Audio_Visual_Equipment.label: Audio Visual Equipment
brick:Audio_Visual_Equipment.definition: Equipment related to sound and visual components such as speakers and displays.

brick:Automatic_Switch.label: Automatic Switch
brick:Automatic_Switch.definition: An automatic switch operates automatically in the event of some current threshold or other designed event. Criteria for automatic operation is generally a physical property of the switch.

brick:Average_Cooling_Demand_Sensor.label: Average Cooling Demand Sensor
brick:Average_Cooling_Demand_Sensor.definition: Measures the average power consumed by a cooling process as the amount of power consumed over some interval

brick:Average_Heating_Demand_Sensor.label: Average Heating Demand Sensor
brick:Average_Heating_Demand_Sensor.definition: Measures the average power consumed by a heating process as the amount of power consumed over some interval

brick:Building_Air_Humidity_Setpoint.label: Building Air Humidity Setpoint
brick:Building_Air_Humidity_Setpoint.definition: Setpoint for humidity in a building

brick:Building_Chilled_Water_Meter.label: Building Chilled Water Meter
brick:Building_Chilled_Water_Meter.definition: A meter that measures the usage or consumption of chilled water of a whole building

brick:Building_Hot_Water_Meter.label: Building Hot Water Meter
brick:Building_Hot_Water_Meter.definition: A meter that measures the usage or consumption of hot water of a whole building

brick:Bypass_Air_Flow_Sensor.label: Bypass Air Flow Sensor
brick:Bypass_Air_Flow_Sensor.definition: Measures the rate of flow of bypass air

brick:Bypass_Water_Flow_Sensor.label: Bypass Water Flow Sensor
brick:Bypass_Water_Flow_Sensor.definition: Measures the rate of flow of bypass water

brick:Bypass_Water_Flow_Setpoint.label: Bypass Water Flow Setpoint
brick:Bypass_Water_Flow_Setpoint.definition: Sets the target flow rate of bypass water

brick:CO2_Alarm_Sensitivity_Parameter.label: CO2 Alarm Sensitivity Parameter
brick:CO2_Alarm_Sensitivity_Parameter.definition: A parameter indicates the sensitivity to activate a CO2 alarm.

brick:CO2_Level_Sensor.label: CO2 Level Sensor
brick:CO2_Level_Sensor.definition: Measures the concentration of CO2 in air

brick:Capillary_Tube_Metering_Device.label: Capillary Tube Metering Device
brick:Capillary_Tube_Metering_Device.definition: A fixed orifice device in refrigeration systems that controls refrigerant flow based on its diameter and length, without moving parts

brick:Chilled_Beam.label: Chilled Beam
brick:Chilled_Beam.definition: A device with an integrated coil that performs sensible heating of a space via circulation of room air. Chilled Beams are not designed to perform latent cooling; see Induction Units. Despite their name, Chilled Beams may perform heating or cooling of a space depending on their configuration.

brick:Chilled_Water_Booster_Pump.label: Chilled Water Booster Pump
brick:Chilled_Water_Booster_Pump.definition: Used to increase the pressure and flow of chilled water in a system to ensure adequate supply where needed.

brick:Chilled_Water_Bypass_Valve.label: Chilled Water Bypass Valve
brick:Chilled_Water_Bypass_Valve.definition: A valve installed in a bypass line of a chilled water loop

brick:Chilled_Water_Circulator_Pump.label: Chilled Water Circulator Pump
brick:Chilled_Water_Circulator_Pump.definition: Used to move chilled water in a closed circuit, ensuring continuous flow.

brick:Chilled_Water_Coil.label: Chilled Water Coil
brick:Chilled_Water_Coil.definition: A cooling element made of pipe or tube that removes heat from equipment, machines or airflows that is filled with chilled water.

brick:Chilled_Water_Isolation_Valve.label: Chilled Water Isolation Valve
brick:Chilled_Water_Isolation_Valve.definition: An isolation valve installed in the chilled water loop

brick:Chilled_Water_Meter.label: Chilled Water Meter
brick:Chilled_Water_Meter.definition: A meter that measures the usage or consumption of chilled water

brick:Chilled_Water_Thermal_Expansion_Ta.label: Chilled Water Thermal Expansion Tank
brick:Chilled_Water_Thermal_Expansion_Ta.definition: A thermal expansion tank designed specifically for chilled water systems.

brick:Collection_Basin_Water_Heater.label: Collection Basin Water Heater
brick:Collection_Basin_Water_Heater.definition: Basin heaters prevent cold water basin freeze-up, e.g. in cooling towers, closed circuit fluid coolers, or evaporative condensers

brick:Condenser_Water_Booster_Pump.label: Condenser Water Booster Pump
brick:Condenser_Water_Booster_Pump.definition: Used to increase the pressure and flow of condenser water in a system to ensure adequate supply where needed.

brick:Condenser_Water_Bypass_Valve.label: Condenser Water Bypass Valve
brick:Condenser_Water_Bypass_Valve.definition: A valve installed in a bypass line of a condenser water loop

brick:Condenser_Water_Circulator_Pump.label: Condenser Water Circulator Pump
brick:Condenser_Water_Circulator_Pump.definition: Used to move chilled water in a closed circuit, ensuring continuous flow.

brick:Condenser_Water_Isolation_Valve.label: Condenser Water Isolation Valve
brick:Condenser_Water_Isolation_Valve.definition: An isolation valve installed in the condenser water loop

brick:Condensing_Natural_Gas_Boiler.label: Condensing Natural Gas Boiler
brick:Condensing_Natural_Gas_Boiler.definition: A closed, pressure vessel that uses natural gas and heat exchanger that capture and reuse any latent heat for heating water or other fluids to supply steam or hot water for heating, humidification, or other applications.

brick:Cooling_Coil.label: Cooling Coil
brick:Cooling_Coil.definition: A cooling element made of pipe or tube that removes heat from equipment, machines or airflows. Typically filled with either refrigerant or cold water.

brick:Cooling_Demand_Sensor.label: Cooling Demand Sensor
brick:Cooling_Demand_Sensor.definition: Measures the amount of power consumed by a cooling process; typically found by multiplying the tonnage of a unit (e.g. RTU) by the efficiency rating in kW/ton

brick:Current_Ratio_Setpoint.label: Current Ratio Setpoint
brick:Current_Ratio_Setpoint.definition: Sets the ratio of currents in a transformer

brick:DC_Bus_Voltage_Sensor.label: DC Bus Voltage Sensor
brick:DC_Bus_Voltage_Sensor.definition: Measures the voltage across a DC bus

brick:Deionised_Water_Conductivity_Senso.label: Deionised Water Conductivity Sensor
brick:Deionised_Water_Conductivity_Senso.definition: Measures the electrical conductance of deionised water

brick:Deionised_Water_Level_Sensor.label: Deionised Water Level Sensor
brick:Deionised_Water_Level_Sensor.definition: Measures the height/level of deionised water in some container

brick:Differential_Pressure_Bypass_Valve.label: Differential Pressure Bypass Valve
brick:Differential_Pressure_Bypass_Valve.definition: A 2-way, self contained proportional valve with an integral differential pressure adjustment setting.

brick:Disable_Differential_Enthalpy_Comm.label: Disable Differential Enthalpy Command
brick:Disable_Differential_Enthalpy_Comm.definition: Disables the use of differential enthalpy control

brick:Disable_Differential_Temperature_C.label: Disable Differential Temperature Command
brick:Disable_Differential_Temperature_C.definition: Disables the use of differential temperature control

brick:Disable_Fixed_Enthalpy_Command.label: Disable Fixed Enthalpy Command
brick:Disable_Fixed_Enthalpy_Command.definition: Disables the use of fixed enthalpy control

brick:Disable_Fixed_Temperature_Command.label: Disable Fixed Temperature Command
brick:Disable_Fixed_Temperature_Command.definition: Disables the use of fixed temperature temperature

brick:Displacement_Flow_Air_Diffuser.label: Displacement Flow Air Diffuser
brick:Displacement_Flow_Air_Diffuser.definition: An air diffuser that is designed for low discharge air speeds to minimize turbulence and induction of room air. This diffuser is used with displacement ventilation systems.

brick:Electrical_Energy_Usage_Sensor.label: Electrical Energy Usage Sensor
brick:Electrical_Energy_Usage_Sensor.definition: A sensor that records the quantity of electrical energy consumed in a given period

brick:Embedded_Temperature_Sensor.label: Embedded Temperature Sensor
brick:Embedded_Temperature_Sensor.definition: Measures the internal temperature of the radiant layer of the radiant heating and cooling HVAC system.

brick:Embedded_Temperature_Setpoint.label: Embedded Temperature Setpoint
brick:Embedded_Temperature_Setpoint.definition: Sets temperature for the internal material, e.g. concrete slab, of the radiant panel.

brick:Emergency_Push_Button_Status.label: Emergency Push Button Status
brick:Emergency_Push_Button_Status.definition: Indicates if an emergency button has been pushed

brick:Enable_Differential_Enthalpy_Comma.label: Enable Differential Enthalpy Command
brick:Enable_Differential_Enthalpy_Comma.definition: Enables the use of differential enthalpy control

brick:Enable_Differential_Temperature_Co.label: Enable Differential Temperature Command
brick:Enable_Differential_Temperature_Co.definition: Enables the use of differential temperature control

brick:Enable_Fixed_Enthalpy_Command.label: Enable Fixed Enthalpy Command
brick:Enable_Fixed_Enthalpy_Command.definition: Enables the use of fixed enthalpy control

brick:Enable_Fixed_Temperature_Command.label: Enable Fixed Temperature Command
brick:Enable_Fixed_Temperature_Command.definition: Enables the use of fixed temperature control

brick:Entering_Water_Pressure_Sensor.label: Entering Water Pressure Sensor
brick:Entering_Water_Pressure_Sensor.definition: Measures the water pressure at the entry point of a system.

brick:Entering_Water_Temperature_Alarm.label: Entering Water Temperature Alarm
brick:Entering_Water_Temperature_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates off-normal conditions associated with the temperature of water entering a piece of equipment or system

brick:Exhaust_Air_Temperature_Sensor.label: Exhaust Air Temperature Sensor
brick:Exhaust_Air_Temperature_Sensor.definition: Measures the temperature of exhaust air

brick:Failure_Alarm.label: Failure Alarm
brick:Failure_Alarm.definition: Alarms that indicate the failure of devices, equipment, systems and control loops

brick:Fault_Status.label: Fault Status
brick:Fault_Status.definition: Indicates the presence of a fault in a device, system or control loop

brick:Fire_Control_Panel.label: Fire Control Panel
brick:Fire_Control_Panel.definition: A panel-mounted device that provides status and control of a fire safety system

brick:Fire_Sprinkler_Thermal_Expansion_T.label: Fire Sprinkler Thermal Expansion Tank
brick:Fire_Sprinkler_Thermal_Expansion_T.definition: A specialized thermal expansion tank that is part of a building's fire suppression system.

brick:Frequency_Command.label: Frequency Command
brick:Frequency_Command.definition: Controls the frequency of a device's operation (e.g. rotational frequency)

brick:Heat_Pump_Air_Source_Condensing_Un.label: Heat Pump Air Source Condensing Unit

brick:Heat_Pump_Ground_Source_Condensing.label: Heat Pump Ground Source Condensing Unit

brick:Heat_Pump_Water_Source_Condensing_.label: Heat Pump Water Source Condensing Unit

brick:Heating_Coil.label: Heating Coil
brick:Heating_Coil.definition: A heating element typically made of pipe, tube or wire that emits heat. Typically filled with hot water, or, in the case of wire, uses electricity.

brick:Heating_Demand_Sensor.label: Heating Demand Sensor
brick:Heating_Demand_Sensor.definition: Measures the amount of power consumed by a heating process; typically found by multiplying the tonnage of a unit (e.g. RTU) by the efficiency rating in kW/ton

brick:High_Air_Flow_Alarm.label: High Air Flow Alarm
brick:High_Air_Flow_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates that the air flow is higher than normal.

brick:High_Head_Pressure_Alarm.label: High Head Pressure Alarm
brick:High_Head_Pressure_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates a high pressure generated on the output side of a gas compressor in a refrigeration or air conditioning system.

brick:High_Humidity_Alarm_Parameter.label: High Humidity Alarm Parameter
brick:High_Humidity_Alarm_Parameter.definition: A parameter determining the humidity level at which to trigger a high humidity alarm

brick:High_Temperature_Alarm_Parameter.label: High Temperature Alarm Parameter
brick:High_Temperature_Alarm_Parameter.definition: A parameter determining the temperature level at which to trigger a high temperature alarm

brick:Hot_Water_Baseboard_Radiator.label: Hot Water Baseboard Radiator
brick:Hot_Water_Baseboard_Radiator.definition: Hydronic heating device located at or near the floor

brick:Hot_Water_Booster_Pump.label: Hot Water Booster Pump
brick:Hot_Water_Booster_Pump.definition: Used to increase the pressure and flow of hot water in a system to ensure adequate supply where needed.

brick:Hot_Water_Coil.label: Hot Water Coil
brick:Hot_Water_Coil.definition: A heating element typically made of pipe, tube or wire that emits heat that is filled with hot water.

brick:Hot_Water_Meter.label: Hot Water Meter
brick:Hot_Water_Meter.definition: A meter that measures the usage or consumption of hot water

brick:Hot_Water_Thermal_Expansion_Tank.label: Hot Water Thermal Expansion Tank
brick:Hot_Water_Thermal_Expansion_Tank.definition: A thermal expansion tank used in hot water heating systems.

brick:Hot_Water_Usage_Sensor.label: Hot Water Usage Sensor
brick:Hot_Water_Usage_Sensor.definition: Measures the amount of hot water that is consumed, over some period of time

brick:Humidity_Alarm.label: Humidity Alarm
brick:Humidity_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates the off-normal conditions associated with the concentration of water vapor in the air.

brick:Humidity_Sensor.label: Humidity Sensor
brick:Humidity_Sensor.definition: Measures the concentration of water vapor in air

brick:Imbalance_Sensor.label: Imbalance Sensor
brick:Imbalance_Sensor.definition: A sensor which measures difference (imbalance) between phases of an electrical system

brick:Isolation_Valve.label: Isolation Valve
brick:Isolation_Valve.definition: A valve that stops the flow of a fluid, usually for maintenance or safety purposes

brick:Jet_Nozzle_Air_Diffuser.label: Jet Nozzle Air Diffuser
brick:Jet_Nozzle_Air_Diffuser.definition: An air diffuser that is designed to produce high velocity discharge air stream to throw the air over a large distance or target the air stream to a localize area

brick:Laminar_Flow_Air_Diffuser.label: Laminar Flow Air Diffuser
brick:Laminar_Flow_Air_Diffuser.definition: An air diffuser that is designed for low discharge air speeds to provide uniform and unidirectional air pattern which minimizes room air entrainment

brick:Last_Fault_Code_Status.label: Last Fault Code Status
brick:Last_Fault_Code_Status.definition: Indicates the last fault code that occurred

brick:Lead_On_Off_Command.label: Lead On Off Command
brick:Lead_On_Off_Command.definition: Controls the active/inactive status of the "lead" part of a lead/lag system

brick:Leaving_Water_Pressure_Sensor.label: Leaving Water Pressure Sensor
brick:Leaving_Water_Pressure_Sensor.definition: Measures the water pressure at the exit point of a system.

brick:Leaving_Water_Temperature_Alarm.label: Leaving Water Temperature Alarm
brick:Leaving_Water_Temperature_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates off-normal conditions associated with the temperature of water leaving a piece of equipment or system

brick:Lighting_Level_Command.label: Lighting Level Command
brick:Lighting_Level_Command.definition: Controls the amount of the light provided by the device typically in percentages.

brick:Low_Humidity_Alarm_Parameter.label: Low Humidity Alarm Parameter
brick:Low_Humidity_Alarm_Parameter.definition: A parameter determining the humidity level at which to trigger a low humidity alarm

brick:Low_Suction_Pressure_Alarm.label: Low Suction Pressure Alarm
brick:Low_Suction_Pressure_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates a low suction pressure in the compressor in a refrigeration or air conditioning system.

brick:Low_Temperature_Alarm_Parameter.label: Low Temperature Alarm Parameter
brick:Low_Temperature_Alarm_Parameter.definition: A parameter determining the temperature level at which to trigger a low temperature alarm

brick:Max_Position_Setpoint_Limit.label: Max Position Setpoint Limit
brick:Max_Position_Setpoint_Limit.definition: A parameter that places an upper bound on the range of permitted values of a Position_Setpoint.

brick:Max_Water_Level_Alarm.label: Max Water Level Alarm
brick:Max_Water_Level_Alarm.definition: Alarm indicating that the maximum water level was reached

brick:Min_Position_Setpoint_Limit.label: Min Position Setpoint Limit
brick:Min_Position_Setpoint_Limit.definition: A parameter that places a lower bound on the range of permitted values of a Position_Setpoint.

brick:Min_Water_Level_Alarm.label: Min Water Level Alarm
brick:Min_Water_Level_Alarm.definition: Alarm indicating that the minimum water level was reached

brick:Mixed_Air_Flow_Sensor.label: Mixed Air Flow Sensor
brick:Mixed_Air_Flow_Sensor.definition: Measures the rate of flow of mixed air

brick:Mixed_Air_Temperature_Sensor.label: Mixed Air Temperature Sensor
brick:Mixed_Air_Temperature_Sensor.definition: Measures the temperature of mixed air

brick:Natural_Gas_Flow_Sensor.label: Natural Gas Flow Sensor
brick:Natural_Gas_Flow_Sensor.definition: Measures the rate of flow of natural gas

brick:Natural_Gas_Temperature_Sensor.label: Natural Gas Temperature Sensor
brick:Natural_Gas_Temperature_Sensor.definition: Measures the temperature of natural gas

brick:Natural_Gas_Usage_Sensor.label: Natural Gas Usage Sensor
brick:Natural_Gas_Usage_Sensor.definition: Measures the amount of natural gas that is consumed or used, over some period of time

brick:Noncondensing_Natural_Gas_Boiler.label: Noncondensing Natural Gas Boiler
brick:Noncondensing_Natural_Gas_Boiler.definition: A closed, pressure vessel that uses natural gas with no system to capture latent heat for heating water or other fluids to supply steam or hot water for heating, humidification, or other applications.

brick:Occupied_Cooling_Temperature_Setpo.label: Occupied Cooling Temperature Setpoint
brick:Occupied_Cooling_Temperature_Setpo.definition: Sets temperature for cooling when occupied

brick:Occupied_Heating_Temperature_Setpo.label: Occupied Heating Temperature Setpoint
brick:Occupied_Heating_Temperature_Setpo.definition: Sets temperature for heating when occupied

brick:On_Status.label: On Status
brick:On_Status.definition: Indicates if a control loop, relay or equipment is on

brick:Operating_Mode_Status.label: Operating Mode Status
brick:Operating_Mode_Status.definition: Indicates the current operating mode of a system, device or control loop

brick:Outside_Air_CO2_Sensor.label: Outside Air CO2 Sensor
brick:Outside_Air_CO2_Sensor.definition: Measures the concentration of CO2 in outside air

brick:Outside_Air_CO_Sensor.label: Outside Air CO Sensor
brick:Outside_Air_CO_Sensor.definition: Measures the concentration of CO in outside air

brick:Outside_Air_Dewpoint_Sensor.label: Outside Air Dewpoint Sensor
brick:Outside_Air_Dewpoint_Sensor.definition: Senses the dewpoint temperature of outside air

brick:Outside_Air_Enthalpy_Sensor.label: Outside Air Enthalpy Sensor
brick:Outside_Air_Enthalpy_Sensor.definition: Measures the total heat content of outside air

brick:Outside_Air_Flow_Sensor.label: Outside Air Flow Sensor
brick:Outside_Air_Flow_Sensor.definition: Measures the rate of flow of outside air into the system

brick:Outside_Air_Grains_Sensor.label: Outside Air Grains Sensor
brick:Outside_Air_Grains_Sensor.definition: Measures the mass of water vapor in outside air

brick:Overridden_Status.label: Overridden Status
brick:Overridden_Status.definition: Indicates if the expected operating status of an equipment or control loop has been overridden

brick:Packaged_Air_Source_Heat_Pump.label: Packaged Air Source Heat Pump
brick:Packaged_Air_Source_Heat_Pump.definition: A self-contained unit that uses air as a heat source or sink for heating and cooling purposes.

brick:Packaged_Heat_Pump.label: Packaged Heat Pump
brick:Packaged_Heat_Pump.definition: A self-contained unit designed to transfer heat energy to or from a designated space, capable of offering both heating and cooling functions

brick:Packaged_Water_Source_Heat_Pump.label: Packaged Water Source Heat Pump
brick:Packaged_Water_Source_Heat_Pump.definition: A self-contained unit that uses water as a heat source or sink for heating and cooling purposes.

brick:Plate_Heat_Exchanger.label: Plate Heat Exchanger
brick:Plate_Heat_Exchanger.definition: A heat exchanger that transfers heat between two separate fluids through thin metal plates.

brick:Position_Command.label: Position Command
brick:Position_Command.definition: Controls or reports the position of some object

brick:Position_Limit.label: Position Limit
brick:Position_Limit.definition: A parameter that places a lower or upper bound on the range of permitted values of a Position_Setpoint.

brick:Power_Sensor.label: Power Sensor
brick:Power_Sensor.definition: Measures the amount of instantaneous power consumed

brick:Pressure_Alarm.label: Pressure Alarm
brick:Pressure_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates the off-normal conditions associated with pressure.

brick:Pressure_Reducing_Valve.label: Pressure Reducing Valve
brick:Pressure_Reducing_Valve.definition: Valve used to reduce a high supply pressure to a usable level; maintains uniform outlet pressure despite inlet pressure variation.

brick:Pressure_Relief_Valve.label: Pressure Relief Valve
brick:Pressure_Relief_Valve.definition: Pressure-actuated valve to automatically relieve excessive pressure; prevents explosive shattering of the housing.

brick:Pump.label: Pump
brick:Pump.definition: Machine for imparting energy to a fluid, causing it to do work, drawing a fluid into itself through an entrance port, and forcing the fluid out through an exhaust port.

brick:Reactive_Energy_Sensor.label: Reactive Energy Sensor
brick:Reactive_Energy_Sensor.definition: Measures the integral of reactive power

brick:Reactive_Power_Sensor.label: Reactive Power Sensor
brick:Reactive_Power_Sensor.definition: Measures the portion of power that, averaged over a complete cycle of the AC waveform, is due to stored energy which returns to the source in each cycle

brick:Refrigerant_Valve.label: Refrigerant Valve
brick:Refrigerant_Valve.definition: A valve controlling the flow or pressure of refrigerant in refrigeration or air conditioning systems, crucial for system efficiency

brick:Return_Air_CO2_Sensor.label: Return Air CO2 Sensor
brick:Return_Air_CO2_Sensor.definition: Measures the concentration of CO2 in return air

brick:Return_Air_CO2_Setpoint.label: Return Air CO2 Setpoint
brick:Return_Air_CO2_Setpoint.definition: Sets some property of CO2 in Return Air

brick:Return_Air_CO_Sensor.label: Return Air CO Sensor
brick:Return_Air_CO_Sensor.definition: Measures the concentration of CO in return air

brick:Return_Air_Dewpoint_Sensor.label: Return Air Dewpoint Sensor
brick:Return_Air_Dewpoint_Sensor.definition: Senses the dewpoint temperature of return air

brick:Return_Air_Enthalpy_Sensor.label: Return Air Enthalpy Sensor
brick:Return_Air_Enthalpy_Sensor.definition: Measures the total heat content of return air

brick:Return_Air_Flow_Sensor.label: Return Air Flow Sensor
brick:Return_Air_Flow_Sensor.definition: Measures the rate of flow of return air

brick:Return_Air_Grains_Sensor.label: Return Air Grains Sensor
brick:Return_Air_Grains_Sensor.definition: Measures the mass of water vapor in return air

brick:Return_Air_Temperature_Sensor.label: Return Air Temperature Sensor
brick:Return_Air_Temperature_Sensor.definition: Measures the temperature of return air

brick:Solar_Azimuth_Angle_Sensor.label: Solar Azimuth Angle Sensor
brick:Solar_Azimuth_Angle_Sensor.definition: Measures the azimuth angle of the sun

brick:Solar_Irradiance_Sensor.label: Solar Irradiance Sensor
brick:Solar_Irradiance_Sensor.definition: Measures solar irradiance levels for photovoltaic systems

brick:Solar_Thermal_Collector.label: Solar Thermal Collector
brick:Solar_Thermal_Collector.definition: A type of solar panels that converts solar radiation into thermal energy.

brick:Solar_Zenith_Angle_Sensor.label: Solar Zenith Angle Sensor
brick:Solar_Zenith_Angle_Sensor.definition: Measures the zenith angle of the sun

brick:Speed_Mode_Status.label: Speed Mode Status
brick:Speed_Mode_Status.definition: Indicates the speed mode of a motor with various categorical settings, such as a multi-state value including low, medium, and high.

brick:Static_Pressure_Sensor.label: Static Pressure Sensor
brick:Static_Pressure_Sensor.definition: Measures resistance to airflow in a heating and cooling system's components and duct work

brick:Storage_Tank.label: Storage Tank
brick:Storage_Tank.definition: A specialized type of tank intended primarily for the storage of fluids or gases for extended periods.

brick:Tank.label: Tank
brick:Tank.definition: A container designed to hold or store fluids for various applications within a system.

brick:Temperature_Alarm_Sensitivity_Para.label: Temperature Alarm Sensitivity Parameter
brick:Temperature_Alarm_Sensitivity_Para.definition: A parameter indicates the sensitivity to activate a temperature alarm.

brick:Thermal_Energy_Usage_Sensor.label: Thermal Energy Usage Sensor
brick:Thermal_Energy_Usage_Sensor.definition: A sensor that records the quantity of thermal energy consumed in a given period

brick:Thermal_Expansion_Tank.label: Thermal Expansion Tank
brick:Thermal_Expansion_Tank.definition: A tank designed to accommodate the expansion and contraction of a fluid, typically water, in a closed heating or cooling system.

brick:Tolerance_Parameter.label: Tolerance Parameter
brick:Tolerance_Parameter.definition: difference between upper and lower limits of size for a given nominal dimension or value.

brick:Transfer_Switch.label: Transfer Switch
brick:Transfer_Switch.definition: An electrical switch that switches a load between two (or more) sources.

brick:Underfloor_Air_Temperature_Sensor.label: Underfloor Air Temperature Sensor
brick:Underfloor_Air_Temperature_Sensor.definition: Measures the temperature of underfloor air

brick:Unoccupied_Cooling_Mode_Status.label: Unoccupied Cooling Mode Status
brick:Unoccupied_Cooling_Mode_Status.definition: Indicates whether a system, device or control loop is in an unoccupied cooling mode

brick:Unoccupied_Heating_Mode_Status.label: Unoccupied Heating Mode Status
brick:Unoccupied_Heating_Mode_Status.definition: Indicates whether a system, device or control loop is in an unoccupied heating mode

brick:Vent_Operating_Mode_Status.label: Vent Operating Mode Status
brick:Vent_Operating_Mode_Status.definition: Indicates the current operating mode of a vent

brick:Ventilation_Air_Flow_Ratio_Limit.label: Ventilation Air Flow Ratio Limit
brick:Ventilation_Air_Flow_Ratio_Limit.definition: A parameter that places a lower or upper bound on the range of permitted values of a Ventilation_Air_Flow_Ratio_Setpoint.

brick:Voltage_Ratio_Setpoint.label: Voltage Ratio Setpoint
brick:Voltage_Ratio_Setpoint.definition: Sets the ratio of voltage in a transformer

brick:Warm_Cool_Adjust_Sensor.label: Warm Cool Adjust Sensor
brick:Warm_Cool_Adjust_Sensor.definition: User provided adjustment of zone temperature, typically in the range of +/- 5 degrees

brick:Water_Cooled_Condenser_Heat_Exchan.label: Water Cooled Condenser Heat Exchanger
brick:Water_Cooled_Condenser_Heat_Exchan.definition: A type of heat exchanger used in refrigeration and air conditioning systems where the primary refrigerant vapor condenses into liquid by transferring heat to circulating water. This process typically occurs in a shell-and-tube or plate heat exchanger.

brick:Water_Differential_Temperature_Set.label: Water Differential Temperature Setpoint
brick:Water_Differential_Temperature_Set.definition: Sets the target differential temperature between the start and end of a heat transfer cycle in a water circuit

brick:Water_Heater.label: Water Heater
brick:Water_Heater.definition: An apparatus for heating and usually storing hot water

brick:Water_System.label: Water System
brick:Water_System.definition: The equipment, devices and conduits that handle the production and distribution of water in a building

brick:Water_Usage_Sensor.label: Water Usage Sensor
brick:Water_Usage_Sensor.definition: Measures the amount of water that is consumed, over some period of time

brick:Zone_CO2_Level_Sensor.label: Zone CO2 Level Sensor
brick:Zone_CO2_Level_Sensor.definition: A physical or virtual sensor which represents the CO2 level of an HVAC Zone

brick:Air_Diffuser.label: Air Diffuser
brick:Air_Diffuser.definition: A device that is a component of the air distribution system that controls the delivery of conditioned and/or ventilating air into a room

brick:Air_Enthalpy_Sensor.label: Air Enthalpy Sensor
brick:Air_Enthalpy_Sensor.definition: Measures the total heat content of air

brick:Air_Flow_Deadband_Setpoint.label: Air Flow Deadband Setpoint
brick:Air_Flow_Deadband_Setpoint.definition: Sets the size of a deadband of air flow

brick:Air_Grains_Sensor.label: Air Grains Sensor
brick:Air_Grains_Sensor.definition: Measures the mass of water vapor in air

brick:Air_Plenum.label: Air Plenum
brick:Air_Plenum.definition: A component of the HVAC the receives air from the air handling unit or room to distribute or exhaust to or from the building

brick:Alarm_Sensitivity_Parameter.label: Alarm Sensitivity Parameter
brick:Alarm_Sensitivity_Parameter.definition: A parameter indicates the sensitivity to activate an alarm.

brick:Automation_Collection.label: Automation Collection
brick:Automation_Collection.definition: A collection of equipment, points, and other automation collections that are logically grouped together for the purpose of management, control, or organization within a building automation system.
