We encourage that you develop your own sub-classes of Automation_Collection to represent specific groupings relevant to your use case.

brick:Average_Zone_Air_Temperature_Senso.label: Average Zone Air Temperature Sensor
brick:Average_Zone_Air_Temperature_Senso.definition: The computed average temperature of air in a zone, over some period of time

brick:Baseboard_Radiator.label: Baseboard Radiator
brick:Baseboard_Radiator.definition: Steam, hydronic, or electric heating device located at or near the floor.

brick:Booster_Pump.label: Booster Pump
brick:Booster_Pump.definition: Used to increase the pressure and flow of a fluid, typically water, in a system to ensure adequate supply where needed.

brick:Building_Air_Static_Pressure_Senso.label: Building Air Static Pressure Sensor
brick:Building_Air_Static_Pressure_Senso.definition: The static pressure of air within a building

brick:Building_Air_Static_Pressure_Setpo.label: Building Air Static Pressure Setpoint
brick:Building_Air_Static_Pressure_Setpo.definition: Sets static pressure of the entire building

brick:Bypass_Valve.label: Bypass Valve
brick:Bypass_Valve.definition: A type of valve installed in a bypass pipeline

brick:Chilled_Water_Differential_Pressur.label: Chilled Water Differential Pressure Sensor
brick:Chilled_Water_Differential_Pressur.definition: Measures the difference in water pressure on either side of a chilled water valve

brick:Chilled_Water_Differential_Tempera.label: Chilled Water Differential Temperature Sensor
brick:Chilled_Water_Differential_Tempera.definition: Measures the difference in temperature between the entering water to the chiller or other water cooling device and leaving water from the same chiller or other water cooling device

brick:Chilled_Water_Gauge_Pressure_Senso.label: Chilled Water Gauge Pressure Sensor
brick:Chilled_Water_Gauge_Pressure_Senso.definition: Sensor measuring the gauge pressure (zero-referenced against ambient air pressure) of chilled water

brick:Chilled_Water_Pump.label: Chilled Water Pump
brick:Chilled_Water_Pump.definition: A pump that performs work on chilled water; typically part of a chilled water system

brick:Chilled_Water_Static_Pressure_Setp.label: Chilled Water Static Pressure Setpoint
brick:Chilled_Water_Static_Pressure_Setp.definition: Sets static pressure of chilled water

brick:Chilled_Water_System_Enable_Comman.label: Chilled Water System Enable Command
brick:Chilled_Water_System_Enable_Comman.definition: Enables operation of the chilled water system

brick:Chiller.label: Chiller
brick:Chiller.definition: Refrigerating machine used to transfer heat between fluids. Chillers are either direct expansion with a compressor or absorption type.

brick:Circulator_Pump.label: Circulator Pump
brick:Circulator_Pump.definition: Used to move hot or cold water in a closed circuit, ensuring continuous fluid flow.

brick:Coldest_Zone_Air_Temperature_Senso.label: Coldest Zone Air Temperature Sensor
brick:Coldest_Zone_Air_Temperature_Senso.definition: The zone temperature that is coldest; drives the supply temperature of hot air. A computed value rather than a physical sensor. Also referred to as a 'Lowest Zone Air Temperature Sensor'

brick:Collection_Basin_Water_Level_Alarm.label: Collection Basin Water Level Alarm
brick:Collection_Basin_Water_Level_Alarm.definition: An alarm that indicates a high or low level of water in the collection basin, e.g. within a Cooling_Tower

brick:Collection_Basin_Water_Level_Senso.label: Collection Basin Water Level Sensor
brick:Collection_Basin_Water_Level_Senso.definition: Measures the level of the water in the collection basin, e.g. within a Cooling_Tower

brick:Collection_Basin_Water_Temperature.label: Collection Basin Water Temperature Sensor
brick:Collection_Basin_Water_Temperature.definition: Measures the temperature of the water in the collection basin, e.g. within a Cooling_Tower

brick:Condenser_Heat_Exchanger.label: Condenser Heat Exchanger
brick:Condenser_Heat_Exchanger.definition: A heat exchanger in which the primary heat transfer vapor changes its state to a liquid phase.

brick:Condenser_Water_Pump.label: Condenser Water Pump
brick:Condenser_Water_Pump.definition: A pump that is part of a condenser system; the pump circulates condenser water from the chiller back to the cooling tower

brick:Cooling_Mode_Status.label: Cooling Mode Status
brick:Cooling_Mode_Status.definition: Indicates whether a system, device or control loop is in a cooling mode

brick:Current_Output_Sensor.label: Current Output Sensor
brick:Current_Output_Sensor.definition: Senses the amperes of electrical current produced as output by a device

brick:Current_Sensor.label: Current Sensor
brick:Current_Sensor.definition: Senses the amperes of electrical current passing through the sensor

brick:Demand_Sensor.label: Demand Sensor
brick:Demand_Sensor.definition: Measures the amount of power consumed by the use of some process; typically found by multiplying the tonnage of a unit (e.g. RTU) by the efficiency rating in kW/ton

brick:Differential_Setpoint.label: Differential Setpoint
brick:Differential_Setpoint.definition: A type of Setpoints that is related to the difference between two measurements

brick:Differential_Temperature_Setpoint.label: Differential Temperature Setpoint
brick:Differential_Temperature_Setpoint.definition: A type of Setpoints that is related to the difference between two temperature measurements

brick:Domestic_Hot_Water_Circulator_Pump.label: Domestic Hot Water Circulator Pump

brick:Supply_District_Hot_Water.definition: District hot water being supplied on the district or utility side of a system or interface

brick:Supply_Heating_Hot_Water.label: Supply Heating Hot Water
brick:Supply_Heating_Hot_Water.definition: Heating hot water being supplied on the load side of a water system

brick:Bypass_Air.label: Bypass Air
brick:Bypass_Air.definition: air in a bypass duct, used to relieve static pressure

brick:Bypass_Water.label: Bypass Water
brick:Bypass_Water.definition: Water that circumvents a piece of equipment or system

brick:Collection_Basin_Water.label: Collection Basin Water
brick:Collection_Basin_Water.definition: Water transiently collected and directed to the sump or pump suction line, typically integral with a cooling tower

brick:Deionized_Water.label: Deionized Water
brick:Deionized_Water.definition: Water which has been purified by removing its ions (constituting the majority of non-particulate contaminants)

brick:Fluid.label: Fluid
brick:Fluid.definition: substance, as a liquid or gas, that is capable of flowing and that changes shape when acted on by a force.

brick:Particulate_Matter.label: Particulate Matter
brick:Particulate_Matter.definition: a mixture of solid particles and liquid droplets found in the air

brick:Return_Chilled_Water.label: Return Chilled Water
brick:Return_Chilled_Water.definition: Chilled water in the return side of a chilled water loop

brick:Return_Hot_Water.label: Return Hot Water
brick:Return_Hot_Water.definition: Hot water in the return side of a hot water loop

brick:Supply_Chilled_Water.label: Supply Chilled Water
brick:Supply_Chilled_Water.definition: Chilled water in the supply side of a chilled water loop

brick:Supply_Hot_Water.label: Supply Hot Water
brick:Supply_Hot_Water.definition: Hot water in the supply side of a hot water loop

brick:Entering_Building_Hot_Water.label: Entering Building Hot Water
brick:Entering_Building_Hot_Water.definition: Building hot water entering a piece of equipment or interface

brick:Entering_District_Hot_Water.label: Entering District Hot Water
brick:Entering_District_Hot_Water.definition: District hot water entering a piece of equipment or interface

brick:Entering_Heating_Hot_Water.label: Entering Heating Hot Water
brick:Entering_Heating_Hot_Water.definition: Heating hot water entering a piece of equipment or system

brick:Leaving_Building_Hot_Water.label: Leaving Building Hot Water
brick:Leaving_Building_Hot_Water.definition: Building hot water leaving a piece of equipment or interface

brick:Leaving_District_Hot_Water.label: Leaving District Hot Water
brick:Leaving_District_Hot_Water.definition: District hot water leaving a piece of equipment or interface

brick:Leaving_Heating_Hot_Water.label: Leaving Heating Hot Water
brick:Leaving_Heating_Hot_Water.definition: Heating hot water leaving a piece of equipment or system

brick:Solid.label: Solid
brick:Solid.definition: one of the three states or phases of matter characterized by stability of dimensions, relative incompressibility, and molecular motion held to limited oscillation.

brick:District_Hot_Water.label: District Hot Water
brick:District_Hot_Water.definition: Heating hot water on the district or utility side of an interface such as a heat exchanger

brick:Entering_Condenser_Water.label: Entering Condenser Water
brick:Entering_Condenser_Water.definition: In a condenser water loop, this is water being brought away from the condenser side of a heat-rejection device (e.g. chiller). It is the 'warm' side.

brick:Leaving_Condenser_Water.label: Leaving Condenser Water
brick:Leaving_Condenser_Water.definition: In a condenser water loop, this is water being brought to the condenser side of a heat-rejection device (e.g. chiller). It is the 'cold' side.

brick:Natural_Gas.label: Natural Gas
brick:Natural_Gas.definition: Fossil fuel energy source consisting largely of methane and other hydrocarbons

brick:Building_Hot_Water.label: Building Hot Water
brick:Building_Hot_Water.definition: Heating hot water on the building or load side of an interface such as a heat exchanger

brick:Entering_Hot_Water.label: Entering Hot Water
brick:Entering_Hot_Water.definition: Hot water entering a piece of equipment or system

brick:Liquid.label: Liquid
brick:Liquid.definition: state of matter intermediate between crystalline substances and gases in which the volume of a substance, but not the shape, remains relatively constant.

brick:Mixed_Air.label: Mixed Air
brick:Mixed_Air.definition: (1) air that contains two or more streams of air. (2) combined outdoor air and recirculated air.

brick:Entering_Chilled_Water.label: Entering Chilled Water
brick:Entering_Chilled_Water.definition: Chilled water that is entering a piece of equipment or system

brick:Leaving_Chilled_Water.label: Leaving Chilled Water
brick:Leaving_Chilled_Water.definition: Chilled water that is leaving a piece of equipment or system

brick:Return_Water.label: Return Water
brick:Return_Water.definition: Water in the return side of a water loop

brick:Supply_Water.label: Supply Water
brick:Supply_Water.definition: Water being supplied to the load-side of a water system

brick:Leaving_Hot_Water.label: Leaving Hot Water
brick:Leaving_Hot_Water.definition: Hot water leaving a piece of equipment or system

brick:Zone_Air.label: Zone Air
brick:Zone_Air.definition: air inside a defined zone (e.g., corridors).

brick:Condenser_Water.label: Condenser Water
brick:Condenser_Water.definition: Water used used to remove heat through condensation

brick:Heating_Hot_Water.label: Heating Hot Water
brick:Heating_Hot_Water.definition: Hot water used for HVAC or process heating and not intended as domestic hot water

brick:Exhaust_Air.label: Exhaust Air
brick:Exhaust_Air.definition: air that must be removed from a space due to contaminants, regardless of pressurization

brick:Gas.label: Gas
brick:Gas.definition: state of matter in which substances exist in the form of nonaggregated molecules and which, within acceptable limits of accuracy, satisfy the ideal gas laws; usually a highly superheated vapor. See [[state]].

brick:Entering_Water.label: Entering Water
brick:Entering_Water.definition: Water that is entering a piece of equipment within a water system; contrasts with returning water which is specifically water coming back from the load side of the system.

brick:Outside_Air.label: Outside Air
brick:Outside_Air.definition: air external to a defined zone (e.g., corridors).

brick:Return_Air.label: Return Air
brick:Return_Air.definition: air removed from a space to be recirculated or exhausted. Air extracted from a space and totally or partially returned to an air conditioner, furnace, or other heating, cooling, or ventilating system.

brick:Hot_Water.label: Hot Water
brick:Hot_Water.definition: Hot water used for HVAC heating or supply to hot taps

brick:Leaving_Water.label: Leaving Water
brick:Leaving_Water.definition: Water that is leaving a piece of equipment within a water system; contrasts with supply water which is water being supplied to the load side of the system.

brick:Chilled_Water.label: Chilled Water
brick:Chilled_Water.definition: water used as a cooling medium (particularly in air-conditioning systems or in processes) at below ambient temperature.

brick:Supply_Air.label: Supply Air
brick:Supply_Air.definition: (1) air delivered by mechanical or natural ventilation to a space, composed of any combination of outdoor air, recirculated air, or transfer air. (2) air entering a space from an air-conditioning, heating, or ventilating apparatus for the purpose of comfort conditioning. Supply air is generally filtered, fan forced, and either heated, cooled, humidified, or dehumidified as necessary to maintain specified conditions. Only the quantity of outdoor air within the supply airflow may be used as replacement air.

brick:Water.label: Water
brick:Water.definition: transparent, odorless, tasteless liquid; a compound of hydrogen and oxygen (H2O), containing 11.188% hydrogen and 88.812% oxygen by mass; freezing at 32°F (0°C); boiling near 212°F (100°C).

brick:Air.label: Air
brick:Air.definition: the invisible gaseous substance surrounding the earth, a mixture mainly of oxygen and nitrogen.
